method: Clothing quantities start from the trip length in days. Laundry access replaces that with the number of half-trip outfit days plus one drying day, capped at the trip length: ceil(days / 2) + 1. Tops, underwear and socks use that outfit count; bottoms use half of it, rounded up, with a minimum of one. Climate adds hot, mild or cold layers, and each selected activity adds its own wearables and gear. Hiking and gym both need a water bottle, so items are deduplicated by case-insensitive name and the first quantity wins instead of summing. The list is grouped into documents and essentials, clothing, toiletries, gear and your own extras, in that order. Custom items are split on line breaks, trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, limited to 60 characters and 12 entries, and deduplicated case-insensitively. Quantities are capped only by the 30-day input limit; no result is stored, uploaded, sent or measured against real luggage capacity.
